rules: Author optpilot.experiment.yaml in the working directory. Environment defines system behavior; Task defines observations, decision contract, parameters and metrics; Instance binds a Task; Suite selects Instances.

Candidates are parameters, programs or Harbor agent configurations. Generators propose parameters or frozen executable programs using only explicitly allowed feedback. Run detail retains every generation input and output.
Use the supplied application CLI and shared project ledger. Declare supporting files; Core freezes actual files and dependency versions. Never edit result databases, transcripts or provenance.
Review exact suite, candidate and generator versions before execution. Read Run and Trial IDs from real results; report missing scores, failures and matched coverage.
Use public experiment commands and the bundled optpilot-evaluation guide. The old environment/method/study CLI is retired.
